name: @three-ws/assistant-mcp
description: Generate a paste-ready three.ws assistant widget from any AI agent. build_assistant_widget turns a config into an embeddable <script> tag, a frame URL, and a ThreeAssistant.init() snippet for a floating 3D avatar chatbot on any website; list_assistant_options enumerates every avatar, background, mode and data-* attribute you can set. Pure, offline, deterministic, no key, no signer, no payment.
author: nirholas <support@three.ws>
